about: Pairing links and what a reader must make of each (remote.md §4b). pairing.test.ts runs them through shared/pairing.ts and pairing.swift.test.ts through ios/Sources/PairingCode.swift. A vector marked canonical is also exactly what pairingLink prints for its code.

vectors.name: a code for sshd's default port has no port field
a code with a port and two host keys escapes the plus in a fingerprint
the app's own scheme carries the same code
port 22 is stored as the default port
a port with leading zeros is that port
a literal plus in a fingerprint is a plus, not a space
an escaped colon and escaped slashes decode
whitespace and line breaks around a pasted link are trimmed
the link before the fragment is matched without regard to case
the fields may come in any order
a field this version does not know is ignored, even a damaged one
empty fields between separators are ignored
a host key listed twice is kept once, before the keys are counted
an empty string
